name: ecart-pay
description: Cursor plugin for Ecart Pay — live orders, payment links, checkout, and WhatsApp charges via official docs MCP.

ECARTPAY_MODE.title: API mode
ECARTPAY_MODE.description: API host for live MCP actions. Dashboard and OAuth stay on production. sandbox = sandbox.ecartpay.com + sandbox keys; production = ecartpay.com + live keys. Never mix.

ECARTPAY_PUBLIC_KEY.title: Public API key
ECARTPAY_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Fallback public API key when OAuth merchant keys are not available. Must match ECARTPAY_MODE. Prefer OAuth connect for partner integrations.

ECARTPAY_PRIVATE_KEY.title: Private API key
ECARTPAY_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Fallback private API key. Never commit. Must match ECARTPAY_MODE. Prefer OAuth connect.

ECARTPAY_BASE_URL.title: API base URL override
ECARTPAY_BASE_URL.description: Optional explicit API host. Overrides ECARTPAY_MODE. Default is derived from mode (sandbox.ecartpay.com or ecartpay.com).

ECARTPAY_CLIENT_ID.title: OAuth client id
ECARTPAY_CLIENT_ID.description: Partner OAuth application client_id for /connect-oauth. From POST /api/oauth/applications.

ECARTPAY_CLIENT_SECRET.title: OAuth client secret
ECARTPAY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Partner OAuth client_secret. Never commit. Used only on POST /api/oauth/token.

ECARTPAY_REDIRECT_URI.title: OAuth redirect URI
ECARTPAY_REDIRECT_URI.description: Must match an allowed redirect_url on the OAuth application. User pastes the callback code into chat.
